cultivation_relevance: India is the world's largest producer and consumer of chickpea. Vital pulse for protein security and biological nitrogen fixation.

climate_and_soil.temperature_range_celsius: 15°C to 25°C during growth; sensitive to frost and extreme heat (>30°C) at flowering
climate_and_soil.annual_rainfall_mm: 400 - 600 mm; highly suited for rainfed or single-irrigation conditions
climate_and_soil.drainage: Must have good internal drainage; prone to root rot and collar rot in poorly drained waterlogged soils

planting_details.seed_rate: Desi chana: 25 to 30 kg/acre; Kabuli chana: 40 to 45 kg/acre
planting_details.sowing_depth: 7.0 to 10.0 cm (deep sowing places seed in moist zone and minimizes collar rot)

critical_stages: Pod formation stage (65-75 DAS - Do NOT irrigate at peak flowering!)

nutrient_management.fym_manure_per_acre: 2 to 3 tonnes well-decomposed FYM applied before sowing
nutrient_management.recommended_npk_ratio: 8:16:8 kg/acre N:P2O5:K2O (Legume fixes own nitrogen; starter N + adequate Phosphorus essential)
micronutrients: Ammonium molybdate seed coating @ 1 g/kg seed to promote active nodulation

harvest_and_yield.maturity_days: 100 - 120 days for Desi types; 110 - 130 days for Kabuli types
harvest_and_yield.harvesting_signs: Foliage turns reddish-brown to straw yellow; seeds rattle inside dry pods
harvest_and_yield.expected_yield_per_acre: 8 to 12 Quintals per acre under irrigated conditions; 5 to 7 Quintals rainfed
harvest_and_yield.post_harvest_storage: Thresh carefully; dry to <9% moisture; store in hermetic bags to prevent Bruchids (pulse beetle)
